publication_write_rule: Any PR that changes current publication authority for a task MUST update research_task_heads/<task_id>.json in the same PR. Use `python control_plane/research_task_head_serialization.py sync --task-id <TASK_ID>` after creating the immutable publication record.
rule: Every current immutable publication authority must have exactly one deterministic per-task head pointer. Any publication changing current authority must update the same pointer path in the same PR. Concurrent same-task publications therefore contend on one Git path instead of silently adding disjoint immutable files.
